messages.subject: failed to load breedR
messages.body_plain:
Dear Facundo, thank you very much for your creation. I got helped a lot by breedR.
I recently bought new pc but when I load breedR I think something is wrong with it, here is my error message:

Binary dependencies missing. Would you like to install them?  1: Yes 2: No

when I press Yes, it keeps repeating...

Do you have any idea? I already install java for windows 64 bit, I use R 4.4.

It will be great if you have some idea on it.
